rules: Maps a shadow-awarded RFP to the workflows whose real runs exercise that surface on master.
confirmed: the newest promote_after_confirmed_runs (3) success/failure conclusions are all success, the RFP is labeled delphi:shadow and not yet delphi:promoted. Sent once.
miss: the newest conclusion is failure and the one before it was success (a transition), on a delphi:shadow RFP. Sent once per transition.
Skipped and cancelled runs are ignored. An empty workflows list means the shadow lane is not wired yet; nothing is ever inferred.

1424.why: delphi-gate's own signed ledger comments, labels and board edits are the GitHub-native ledger running for real; a failed run (e.g. the 2026-10-20 shared-token 403) is that surface's documented failure mode

1423.why: no Turso-backed lane exists yet; wiring one needs a TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN repo secret (user approval, Access lane)
